facts.statement: Checkout's failed spans show 'connection refused' dialing cart at 10.96.223.207:8080 on GetCart and on PlaceOrder ('cart failure: failed to get user cart during checkout').
Cart's logs end at 15:53:56Z with 'Application is shutting down' and 'Shutting down the feature provider'. No later cart log lines or error traces appear in the 15-minute window.
Of checkout's client spans, only CartService/GetCart shows errors (about 0.09 to 0.1/s). PaymentService/Charge shows 0 errors.
Checkout's error ratio (5m) was 0.23 at 15:44:29Z, peaked at 0.88 at 15:47:59Z, and was 0.44 at 15:56:29Z. Errors predate the alert window and continued after the 15:47 rollback.
Checkout revision 2 (15:42:52Z) set PAYMENT_ADDR to payment:9999. Revision 3 changed only PAYMENT_ADDR back to payment:8080, with the pod starting at 15:47:00.
Payment has one revision (15:30:15Z), is 1/1 ready, and has no error logs. All 18 feature flags are off.
Namespace warnings in the last 120 minutes are readiness probe failures only on alertmanager, otel-collector-agent and loki. No restarts or crashloops are reported for checkout, payment or cart.
Cart's GetCart server span is UNSET at about 0.235/s with p95 about 1.9 ms. No cart STATUS_CODE_ERROR series was returned.
Checkout's PlaceOrder server spans are about 0.142/s ERROR versus 0.046/s UNSET (about 76% erroring), with p95 about 45.7 ms, so the failures are fast refusals, not timeouts.
Frontend (about 0.13) and frontend-proxy (about 0.125) error ratios are below checkout's, consistent with downstream symptoms.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Check cart's pod status, restart count, Endpoints/EndpointSlice for the cart Service, and cart's deployment rollout history and events.
hypotheses.statement: Cart's pod or container exited at 15:53:56 and was not restarted, or its Service has no ready endpoints, so checkout's connections are refused.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Diff checkout revision 1 vs 2 env, and cart's Service spec and container port, and compare with the 10.96.223.207:8080 address seen in traces.
hypotheses.statement: Checkout's CART_ADDR or cart's listening port was changed in an earlier checkout or cart revision (before rev 2), or the Service targetPort is wrong.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Query cart server span counts by pod or instance and by time since 15:50 to confirm they stop at 15:53:56.
hypotheses.statement: The 0.235/s UNSET cart GetCart spans may come from stale or cached span metrics, or a different cart replica still serving. This would conflict with a full shutdown.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Plot checkout GetCart errors against cart pod start time and valkey-cart client span errors from 15:35 to 15:55.
hypotheses.statement: The early checkout errors before 15:53 suggest a second trigger, such as a cart dependency or valkey-cart problem, that preceded the shutdown.

inferences.statement: Checkout's error ratio is driven by the GetCart call to cart, not by payment, Kafka or the rev 2 PAYMENT_ADDR change.
Rolling checkout back to revision 3 did not stop the errors, so the rev 2 to 3 change is not the fix.

root_causes.cause: Cart stopped serving on 8080 around 15:53:56Z (application shutdown, then silence), so checkout's GetCart and PlaceOrder calls are refused. The reason for the shutdown is not established. Cart's pre-shutdown error onset also needs explaining, since checkout errors start before 15:53.

Checkout's 15:42 revision 2 changed PAYMENT_ADDR to port 9999 and the 15:47 rollback restored 8080. The change is real but it does not explain the cart errors, and the error ratio stayed high after the rollback. It is a secondary contributor at most.

diagnosis.summary: Checkout's ErrorBudgetBurn is driven by failed calls to cart. Checkout's GetCart spans get 'connection refused' from cart:8080, and cart logs a shutdown at 15:53:56Z and then goes silent. Payment is ruled out: its Charge spans show zero errors. Checkout's error ratio already reached 0.23 by 15:44 and was still 0.44 at 15:56, after the 15:47 rollback to payment:8080, so the revision 2 to 3 change does not explain the outage. Two gaps remain: cart's own rollout history and pod state were never checked, and cart still shows about 0.235/s UNSET GetCart server spans, which does not fit a fully down service. Checkout is the alerting service and the user-facing symptom; the fix is most likely in cart or in how checkout reaches it.

actions.reason: Cart's only revision is 15:30:15Z, and the pod was killed at 15:53:56 with 'Container cart definition changed' and re-created pulling the pause image, so cart is not serving. A rolling restart recreates the pod from the cart template.

alternatives.why_not: Cart has only revision 1, so there is no earlier revision to return to, and checkout's rev 2 to 3 change is not the cause.
Adding replicas would not help while the only pod is a pause container that refuses connections on 8080.
Checkout was not proposed for restart: its error ratio is driven by cart refusals, not by a stuck checkout process.

plan.summary: Restart the cart Deployment so its pod is recreated from the cart template (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:3.1.0-cart) instead of the pause-image container left after the 15:53:56Z definition-change kill. Checkout's GetCart and PlaceOrder refusals should stop and its error ratio should fall; the cause of the out-of-band definition change still needs a human look.

facts.statement: Cart's last log line is 'Application is shutting down' at 15:53:56Z, with no later cart logs or restart message.
Frontend errors are cart connection failures (166 API errors on /api/cart, 34 checkout failures), running 15:54:54Z to 15:58:11Z.
Checkout's GetCart and PlaceOrder traces fail with connection refused to cart 10.96.223.207:8080.
Checkout's error ratio rose first, from 0.20 at 15:44 to a 0.919 peak at 15:47, matching the revision 2 window.
Frontend's CartService error rate climbed from 0.03 at 15:54 to 0.95 at 15:58.
Cart's own server spans show no STATUS_CODE_ERROR, and its p95 latency is flat at about 1.9 ms.
All 18 flags are off, and flagd's error ratio stays near 0.
No rollout changed frontend, frontend-proxy, payment, product-catalog or cart in the window; the only namespace warnings are readiness probes on other services.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Check cart deployment replicas and scale events, and confirm the cart Service has empty endpoints since 15:53Z.
hypotheses.statement: Cart was scaled to zero or its endpoints were removed at about 15:53Z, outside a rollout.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Query cart server span counts per minute after 15:53:56Z and check for Jaeger cart server spans after that time.
hypotheses.statement: Cart's server metrics are stale or lagging, which is why they show no errors after the shutdown.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Check checkout client spans to payment, currency and shipping after 15:54Z for any errors.
hypotheses.statement: Checkout's 0.76 error ratio at 15:58 is entirely cart-driven rather than a second fault.

inferences.statement: The live fault is cart being unreachable from callers since about 15:54Z; frontend and checkout errors are inherited from it.
Frontend-proxy and flagd are symptoms, not origins.

root_causes.cause: The cart service stopped serving at about 15:53:56Z (graceful shutdown, no restart or rollout found). Callers get connection refused on 10.96.223.207:8080, failing frontend and checkout cart calls. The trigger is unknown; scale-to-zero or endpoint removal is the leading guess.

Checkout revision 2 pointed PAYMENT_ADDR at payment:9999 and caused a burn from about 15:44 to 15:47Z. It was rolled back to revision 3. This is resolved and does not explain the current frontend errors.

diagnosis.summary: The alert fired on frontend, but frontend is a symptom. Its 19% error ratio is almost entirely cart connection failures (connect ECONNREFUSED 10.96.223.207:8080). Cart logged 'Application is shutting down' at 15:53:56Z and has no later logs. Checkout fails on the same cart calls. Checkout's earlier burn came from a bad payment port in revision 2, rolled back by 15:47Z, which does not explain the current refusals. Why cart stopped is not established: no restart or rollout appears, which points to a scale-down, endpoint loss, or external SIGTERM. Cart's own server metrics show no errors, which conflicts with it being down and must be resolved.

alternatives.why_not: Cart has only revision 1 (15:30:15Z); checkout's bad revision was a different service and is already rolled back.
A restart may restore serving, but the cause is unresolved and could recur; hold it for a human after checking cart's pod spec and replicas.
Scale-to-zero is not verified; the events show a container restart, not a scale-down.

plan.no_action_reason: Trigger unknown. Check cart's replica count, endpoints, pod spec and any out-of-band edit or operator action, then restart or scale cart once the cause is known.
plan.summary: Cart is the live fault: its pod was killed and recreated at 15:53:56Z with no rollout, and frontend and checkout errors are cart connection refusals. The trigger is unknown, so no automated action is proposed; a human should find what changed cart's pod before restarting it.

facts.statement: Frontend error logs from 15:57:40Z to 15:58:47Z contain only cart connection failures: ECONNREFUSED 10.96.223.207:8080 (78) and 'failed to get user cart during checkout ... connection refused' (22).
Cart's last log lines are 'Application is shutting down' and feature-provider shutdown at 15:53:56Z. It has no logs or error traces afterward.

Frontend-proxy's 500s come from frontend spans failing with gRPC status 14 on CartService AddItem and GetCart, with the same ECONNREFUSED message. frontend-proxy logs show its 500s marked via_upstream and no error lines of its own.
Frontend's client-side cart error spans begin about 15:55Z. Checkout's PlaceOrder server errors begin at 15:44Z, and checkout logs no error-level lines.
Checkout's misconfiguration ran from 15:42:52Z until rollback at about 15:47Z. Checkout's Charge client errors ran from 15:44 to about 15:50 and then stopped.

All 18 flagd flags are off. No rollout touched frontend-proxy, frontend, or payment after 15:30Z, and no warning events (other than readiness probes at 15:30) appear in the window. The change investigation did not check cart's rollout or events.
Valkey-cart call traffic from cart drops to zero by about 15:48-15:50, before cart's last log at 15:53:56Z.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Check cart's Deployment replicas and ready count, its pod status and last termination reason, and the namespace events filtered to cart since 15:50Z.
hypotheses.statement: Cart's pods were terminated or scaled down around 15:53Z (eviction, OOM, a failed probe, or a manual scale-down), and no restart occurred, so cart has no ready endpoints.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Compare span counts with the otel-collector pipeline and the load generator's request rate for the same window.
hypotheses.statement: The drop in downstream traffic after about 15:50 (product-catalog, shipping, currency, email, payment) reflects a telemetry or load change, not a dependency fault.

inferences.statement: The current frontend-proxy failure is driven by cart being down or not listening since about 15:53:56Z. The logs and traces give a direct connection-refused signal, which is stronger than the metrics signals that point at checkout.
The checkout misconfiguration is not the current cause, because it was rolled back before the failures and checkout's Charge errors stopped at about 15:50.

root_causes.cause: cart stopped serving after a shutdown at about 15:53:56Z, so frontend gets connection refused on cart:8080 and every cart call fails. The reason for the stop is not known (crash, eviction, scale-down, or an external shutdown are all possible).

a PAYMENT_ADDR misconfiguration (payment:9999) from revision 2 caused checkout PaymentService/Charge errors and an early checkout error rise from about 15:44Z. It was rolled back at about 15:47Z and does not explain the current failure.

diagnosis.summary: The frontend-proxy alert is a symptom. frontend-proxy forwards 500s from frontend, and frontend fails every cart call with ECONNREFUSED to cart at 10.96.223.207:8080. Cart's logs stop at a shutdown sequence at 15:53:56Z and it has no spans since, so cart appears to be down or not listening. Checkout's cart calls fail through the same path. The earlier checkout misconfiguration (PAYMENT_ADDR set to port 9999, 15:42-15:47Z) was rolled back and explains only the early checkout burn, not the ongoing failure. Why cart stopped is not established: the change investigation did not check cart's events or pod status.

alternatives.why_not: Cart has only revision 1 (ev_0dea1159177c5421), so there is no earlier revision to return to, and no rollout touched cart.
A restart might bring cart back, but the kill at 15:53:56Z was logged as a definition change and the shutdown may repeat. The cause is unverified, so I do not propose it without confirmation.
Cart is not short of capacity: it shows 1 ready replica (ev_0dea1159177c5421), and the failure is connection refused, not overload.

plan.no_action_reason: Cart's shutdown cause is not established. A human should check cart's pod status, last container exit reason and termination message, and the 15:53:56Z kill source (eviction, manual change, or probe failure), then decide on a restart or a fix. Frontend-proxy, frontend and checkout should not be targeted.
plan.summary: Cart is the likely root cause: it has one revision from 15:30:15Z, no bad release, and its container was killed and recreated at 15:53:56Z with logs ending at a shutdown. None of the available actions clearly fixes that, so I propose no action.
